WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN access='cbc_alert' THEN 'cbc_alert'
      WHEN raw_event_type IS NOT NULL THEN raw_event_type
      WHEN event_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'event_id_' || event_id
      ELSE coalesce(access,'unknown')
    END AS bucket
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE time BETWEEN '2022-07-20 00:54:14' AND '2022-07-20 00:58:14'
    AND (
      lower(coalesce(pname,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'
      OR lower(coalesce(process_name,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'
      OR lower(coalesce(object,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'

      OR lower(coalesce(parent_process_name,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'
      OR lower(coalesce(parent_process_path,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'
      OR lower(coalesce(parent_command_line,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'
      OR lower(coalesce(childproc_name,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'
      OR access = 'cbc_alert'
    )
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bucket ORDER BY abs(strftime('%s',time)-strftime('%s','2022-07-20 00:56:14')), time, coalesce(event_record_id,0), coalesce(source_row_id,'')) AS rn

)
